about_the_game:
"KITTYPOOL's O.S.T. All In One" is an all-in-one package that contains all the salable music tracks from KITTYPOOL games.
More music will be added from time to time for games that will be sold in the future, and the price will be revised each time. In other words, the earlier you get it, the more you save!

What? You say,
"I'm an engineer, so I can decompile games and extract the audio data. I don't need a soundtrack."
...Really? That is the most foolish misconception!

The audio data in KITTYPOOL's works is all in 64kbps ogg files for space reduction, and sometimes they are even normalized or processed into mono.

In contrast, the audio data included in this package is rendered in high quality specifically for the soundtrack.

Furthermore!

Since tag information is registered for all songs, song titles are automatically registered when imported to a smartphone.
